newsitem.title: USA: J. Baker sells Shoe Corp for $40 mln.
newsitem.headline: J. Baker sells Shoe Corp for $40 mln.

text.p: J. Baker Inc said Thursday it has sold its Shoe Corporation of America division to an entity formed by CHB Capital Partners, Dennis Tishkoff, President of Shoe Corp, and certain members of Shoe Corp's management for $40 million.

The sale, said Baker, included Shoe Corp's inventory, fixed assets, intellectual property and license agreements for the various department and specialty store chains. In addition, the buyer assumed certain Shoe Corp liabilities.
The net cash proceeds of the transaction, said the company, will be used to pay down J. Baker's bank debt.
J. Baker, Inc. is a diversified retailer of footwear and apparel.
